{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Indonesia|Cuisine of Indonesia]]

'''Acar campur''' is a very simple Indonesian pickle [[Cookbook:Salad|salad]]. Here is one example, of which there are many variations, some of which depend on what items are in season.

==Ingredients==

* 1 fresh [[Cookbook:Red Pepper|red pepper]], seeded and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], quartered
* 2 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], crushed
* ½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] cube [[Cookbook:Terasi|terasi]] (shrimp paste)
* 4 [[Cookbook:Macadamia Nut|macadamia nut]]s or 8 [[Cookbook:Almond|almond]]s
* 1-inch piece of fresh [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]] or 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] ground [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Corn Oil|corn]], [[Cookbook:Sunflower Oil|sunflower]], or [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 2 cups white [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* ¼ cup white [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 3 medium [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]]s
* 1 small [[Cookbook:Cauliflower|cauliflower]]
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumber]]
* 1 cup white [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]]
* 1 cup dry-roasted [[Cookbook:Peanut|peanut]]s, coarsely crushed
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]], to taste

==Procedure==

# Place the pepper, onion, garlic, shrimp paste, nuts, and turmeric in a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]]. Blend to a paste-like consistency.
# Heat the processed paste mixture in the oil for 2 minutes. Add the vinegar, water, sugar and salt. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] while stirring. [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, while preparing vegetables.
# Cut carrots into desired bite-sized shapes. Cut green beans into short, even lengths. Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets. Peel seeded cucumber and cut into bite-sized cubes. Cut cabbage into bite-sized pieces.
# [[Cookbook:Blanching|Blanch]] each vegetable separately in boiling water for 1 minute. Rinse in cold water to halt the cooking. Drain well.
# Add the vegetables to the boiled paste sauce. Gradually bring the entire mixture to a boil. Cook for 5–10 minutes. Do not overcook—the vegetables should still be crunchy.
# Remove from heat. Add the peanuts to the mixture and cool.
# Once cool, cover and chill for at least 3 days before serving.

==Notes, tips and variations==
* Indonesian pickles tend to include a variety of shredded vegetables and spices, including the following:
** [[Cookbook:Carrot|Carrot]]
** [[Cookbook:Cauliflower|Cauliflower]]
** [[Cookbook:Cucumber|Cucumber]]
** [[Cookbook:Corn|Baby corn]]
** [[Cookbook:Bean Sprouts|Bean sprouts]]
** [[Cookbook:Chili Pepper|Chili pepper]]
** [[Cookbook:Ginger|Ginger]]
** [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|Black pepper]]
** [[Cookbook:Hazelnut|Hazelnut]]
** [[Cookbook:Pistachio|Pistachio]]
** [[Cookbook:Pecan|Pecan]]
